tests.hypothesis: Later advertisements deliberately address different interpretive levels of a shared earlier document.
tests.mechanism: Document date plus level forms a compound reference address.
tests.prediction: Later notices independently return to 1989-05-01 using different level numbers.
tests.confidence: high for printed references; low for any proposed decoding algorithm
tests.alternative: A literary or artistic narrative can use the same structure without an executable cipher.
tests.limitation: Retrospective replication of SR/CL leads; holdout is from construction only, not an unseen or preregistered test.

tests.hypothesis: Every printed Level belongs to one universal system of exactly four classical senses.
tests.mechanism: Literal, allegorical, moral and anagogical levels apply uniformly.
tests.prediction: A numbered Level sequence has no fifth member.
tests.confidence: high against the universal claim; unresolved for a narrower quadrigae-only mapping
tests.contradiction: E7 visibly enumerates a fifth Level but does not call that list quadrigae. Classical senses are not assigned by E1–E3.
tests.limitation: Does not reject all fourfold readings.

tests.hypothesis: The Julian Day labeled The day in May 1989 merely restates the publication date.
tests.mechanism: Standard astronomical Julian Day to civil date conversion.
tests.alternative: Future event date, another time convention, deliberate displacement, or error.
tests.limitation: Single-document falsification; no held-out JD series available. Does not identify what 26 June means.

tests.hypothesis: The corpus sustains a Protestant political and historical canon across decades.
tests.mechanism: Recurring named referents anchor an evolving narrative or ideological vocabulary.
tests.construction_observation: 1989 image prominently labels Cromwell and names Confessio Augustana.
tests.prediction: Later notices return to Cromwell and related Reformation figures.
tests.confidence: high for named recurrence; low for real-world organizational or author identity claims
tests.contradiction: Scientific, financial, musical and multilingual content exceeds a simple religious-message explanation.
tests.limitation: An abbreviated G.A. in 2015 is left unresolved. Selected examples are retrospective and cannot estimate population prevalence.

tests.hypothesis: September 2000 is self-contained and its date references are incidental.
tests.prediction: No explicit instruction depends on a distant advertisement.
tests.observed: E4 explicitly directs DATE AND HOUR to the 1983-11-22 schedule, approximately 17 years earlier.
tests.limitation: The instruction does not prove a physical meeting occurred, nor resolve the time formula.

control.label: Exploratory co-occurrence permutation; not proof of meaning
control.grouping: Same filename-date plus strong near-date geometric-registration groups; all pages contribute mentions.
control.null: Independent uniform column permutations preserve per-name document frequencies.
caveats: Entity selection was informed by prior research; not a confirmatory p-value.
OCR omissions and shared page formats can bias counts.
Uniform permutation ignores time trends and document lengths.
Co-occurrence supports editorial grouping, not cipher correctness or historical truth.
